raw_response:
I learned everything from my father and mother, and from watching what my neighbors do on their own plots. This land is very small, only 0.06 hectares, so one full bag of chemical fertilizer would be far too much and the money is better kept for my children's needs. Last season I spread cow dung around the plants and pulled the weeds by hand, and that is what I will do again this year because it costs nothing and the trees still give fruit. My wife and children will help me with the weeding and harvesting when the time comes, and we do not need to pay outside workers for such a small piece of land.
